create_CheckpointManager: create a CheckpointManager instance with a custom disk root directory for storing checkpoints
add_checkpoint_CheckpointManager: add a new Checkpoint with name, remote_path, fname, and sha256 to the CheckpointManager storage
download_by_name_CheckpointManager: download a registered checkpoint by name from its remote URL to the local disk root
get_by_name_CheckpointManager: get the local file path for a checkpoint by name, downloading it automatically if needed
set_root_CheckpointManager: change the disk root directory of an existing CheckpointManager to a new path
